assistant_outcomes.text: Reviewing the Mag desk UI (window chrome, dock, 3D selection) so we can simplify it and add hover context.
Switching the desk to single-focus panes (no empty stacked windows), simplifying chrome, and adding 3D hover + an inspect panel.

# Desk UI cleanup shipped Hard-refresh Mag (**Ctrl+F5**) so `cli7` assets load — old multi-window state is discarded automatically (`mag_cli_wins_v3`). ## What was wrong - **Stacked empty shells**: every pane stayed “open” as absolute windows; most had no content until selected - **Chrome noise**: min / max / close + drag/resize without a clear model - **Top bar**: status without useful actions - **3D**: click only updated a thin caption — no hover, no fixed inspect panel ## What we did ### Single-focus desk - Dock opens **one full pane** at a time (no layered empty windows) - **× / −** = hide
Diagnosing the conspiracy lattice desk—server, APIs, and frontend.
Invalid `NaN` in the workspace JSON is breaking the browser parser. Locating and sanitizing it.

# Lattice desk fixed and restarted ## What was going wrong 1. **Server often dead** on `:8743` (process exited after restarts from a non-persistent shell). 2. **Desk boot** pulled the full pack with heavy lattice extras first — easy to hang/fail paint. 3. **Map paint** could fail silently if the canvas was still 0×0 on first frame. 4. **Mag lattice page** only linked out; if `:8743` was down it felt “broken.” Backend data itself was fine: full stack still builds **421 nodes**. ## Fixes applied | Fix | Detail | |-----|--------| | Project root | Always `data/knots` from package root, not shell c

Lattice desk is **up** again on **:8743** (health 200). An older process had exited after ~12 min; the current one is serving the hardened desk. **Open with hard refresh (Ctrl+F5):** [http://127.0.0.1:8743/?preset=conspiracy](http://127.0.0.1:8743/?preset=conspiracy) If the map is blank: **Sources → Load full lattice**, or try [demo](http://127.0.0.1:8743/?preset=demo). Mag launcher: [http://127.0.0.1:8765/static/lattice.html](http://127.0.0.1:8765/static/lattice.html)
Reviewing what the desk already produces from knot text so recommendations plug into real signals, not generic viz fashion.

# Why it feels weird (and not profound) The desk is doing **graph-as-product**: one blob of ~400 nodes, many names, soft edges. That matches **structure**, not **insight**. Your own display theory already names the failure: > Graph-as-product (prettier than useful) · Success = cold reader retells in 60s — question · official close · one pattern · residual. Profound insight here is not “more dots.” It is: 1. **Comparison** — same event under incompatible charts 2. **Sequence** — the five-step loop across cases (not one monomania) 3. **Shield phrases** — what kills inquiry in one line 4. **Resid
